query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'target_kind',target_kind,'target_id',target_id,'allow_view',allow_view,'allow_download',allow_download,'allow_like',allow_like,'allow_flag',allow_flag,'expires_at',expires_at,'has_passphrase',passphrase_hash IS NOT NULL,'revoked_at',revoked_at) AS "state!" FROM share_links WHERE id=$1
